exposure: Post-surgical MRI artifacts along the FUS beam path (graded as mild, moderate, or severe)
Prior uterine surgery (myomectomy or Cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 19 patients with uterine fibroids who had prior uterine surgery and visible post-surgical MRI artifacts along the FUS beam path.
finding: The study found no significant correlation between artifact severity and MRgFUS treatment efficacy (percent non-perfused volume) or fibroid size, and no related adverse events, concluding that patients with such artifacts can be successfully treated.
mod_finding: Patients with prior Cesarean section, leading to post-operative susceptibility artifacts, can still be successfully treated with MRgFUS for uterine fibroids.
